title: service-messaging: a durable http node with method GET never delivers through the HTTP outbox (sendOnce sends a '{}' body, fetch refuses GET with a body)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUZKdq3PK2Sab53cT3

Found while building #33655 (PR #33886, Acceptance note 2). Bug only: grade and state are left to triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读

- 现象：持久化（durable）的 http 节点写了 `method: 'GET'`，在配置了消息 HTTP 发件箱时永远投递不出去，重试到投递死亡。
- 原因：发件箱的 `sendOnce` 总是带 `deliveryBody(payload)` 发送，无请求体的节点会变成 `'{}'`，而 Node 的 `fetch` 拒绝带请求体的 GET。
- 影响：#33487 的 changeset 把 `method: 'GET'` 作为保留旧行为的写法，但只在没有发件箱时成立。

## Evidence

- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-sender.ts` `sendOnce` always sends `deliveryBody(payload)`, which is `'{}'` for a bodyless node.
- Probe: `fetch(url, { method: 'GET', body: '{}' })` throws `TypeError: Request with GET/HEAD method cannot have body.`. The dispatcher classes that as a retriable transport failure until the delivery is dead.
- The no-outbox fallback (`sendInline` in `service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts`) sends no body for GET, so it works there. Pinned in PR #33886 (`http-node-signing.test.ts`).

## Expected

A GET or HEAD outbox delivery carries no body (and signs what it sends), or the outbox refuses such a node when it saves rather than at delivery. The released 18.5.0 #33487 CHANGELOG note should match.

Dedupe words: `durable http GET outbox body`, `sendOnce GET body`, `deliveryBody bodyless GET`, `http outbox dead GET`.
